_doc: Canonical venues (#20). Sessions are matched to a venue by name or alias (case and punctuation ignored); a session at a name not listed here is reported as a source warning so it can be added. `parent` nests a sub-facility (a rink inside a sports complex). External ids (osm, googlePlaceId) and coordinates are filled in by discovery (#21) or by hand; leave them null rather than guessing. Only place ids may be stored from Google (refresh yearly); coordinates never come from Google. lat/lng (Nov 2026) are the US Census geocoder's match for the address (public domain), or OpenStreetMap Nominatim's (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL) where Census had no match: austin-pickle-ranch and atx-beach (11000 Middle Fiskville Rd), leander-activity-center, mueller-lake-park (sand courts at Mary Elizabeth Branch Park) and austin-bouldin-braker. The site uses them only for the 📍 distance order. `short` (optional, up to 24 characters) is the name on map pins when the full name is long; otherwise the site shortens it.
